This document represents a diagnostic feedback report generated after an attempt
to upload a retail data feed on 27 January 2026. It serves as a technical log
that identifies specific formatting errors and warnings within a spreadsheet,
such as exceeding character limits or providing excessive sub-attributes. By
pinpointing the exact location of these issues, the file acts as a
troubleshooting guide to help the user refine their product data for successful
integration. Ultimately, the text illustrates the rigid validation process
required to maintain data integrity within digital inventory systems. Happy to
help you analyze this folder!
